candidates.name: Phototoxic maculopathy
support_spans: vision loss and scotomas in the right eye
hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and OCT findings are consistent with phototoxic maculopathy, a condition caused by exposure to high-intensity light

candidates.name: Solar retinopathy
support_spans: exposure to high-intensity LED light
disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
candidates.why: The patient's history of exposure to high-intensity light and the OCT findings are similar to those seen in solar retinopathy

candidates.name: Photoreceptor degeneration
support_spans: disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
decreased foveal peak P1 amplitudes in right eye
candidates.why: The patient's OCT and mfERG findings suggest photoreceptor degeneration, which is a common mechanism in phototoxic maculopathy

candidates.name: Retinal pigment epithelium damage
support_spans: mild eminence of retinal pigment epithelium at fovea
mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
candidates.why: The patient's OCT findings suggest damage to the retinal pigment epithelium, which is a critical component of the retina
